context: Interactive scrollytelling data visualization — a revenue time series with a step-by-step story reveal, event annotations, and a forecast fan chart with 50/80/95% confidence bands.
first_impression: The screenshot captures the initial empty state before any story steps are triggered, leaving the chart area completely blank — axes, gridlines, and title are clean, but there is no data to look at.
what_works: Typographic hierarchy is well-considered: bold 20px title, muted 13px subtitle, and small quiet axis labels create a clear entry point. The Tol muted palette (#4477AA blue, #66CCEE cyan, #AA3377 purple) is an intentional, harmonious choice well above schemeCategory10 defaults.
what_doesnt: The screenshot renders the visualization in a visually broken state — an empty chart with nothing to evaluate — because the story-driven reveal hides all data until the user clicks; there is no ambient state or preview to orient a first-time viewer. Second, the chart height (800px) leaves the bottom half of the viewport as white emptiness in the screenshot, making the layout feel unanchored.
